> 1.3.12 Verify that regular expressions are free from elements causing exponential
backtracking, and ensure untrusted input is sanitized to mitigate ReDoS or
Runaway Regex attacks

Use “escaped or strictly validated” instead of “sanitized,” and mention input length and resource limits. Also add guidance to use safe regex engines or good libraries/tools.

comments.body:
This requirement is confusing. 

The requirement to stop RegEx attacks are about building the regex well and not using user data to build a regex. The whole point of a regex is to do the validations - you don't pre-validate untrusted data before you use a RegEx to validate.

So I suggest we drop the untrusted data bit or clarify that untrusted data should not be included in a regex.
